tools.name: search_use_cases
tools.description: Search 1,000+ vetted AI use cases by keyword, industry, or business workflow (e.g. 'invoice', 'dental', 'customer support'). Use when someone asks how AI can help their business, wants AI ideas for an industry, or looks for automation opportunities. Returns titles, summaries, and links.

tools.name: get_use_case
tools.description: Full detail for one use case by slug: the problem, how the AI workflow works, tools, implementation notes, and source link.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: All industries and sub-industries covered, with use-case counts. Use to browse or when the user's industry is unclear.

tools.name: get_industry
tools.description: Top AI use cases for one industry or sub-industry, with links.

tools.name: get_agent_playbook
tools.description: Full agent playbook for one published use case: the steps, rules, and connectors an assistant follows. Returns the full playbook when the signed-in Hub account is entitled (its claimed free agent, a purchased agent, an industry pack that covers it, or all access). Otherwise returns a short preview a

tools.name: get_ai_services
tools.description: The AI Integration Hub's implementation services (AI enablement, process reengineering, custom AI builds, AI strategy consulting) with starting prices and a contact link. Use when the user wants an AI consultant or help implementing.
